aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets approximately 4% per month, aiming for stretch growth by using leverage and concentration. This approach significantly amplifies both potential gains and drawdowns, and leveraged ETFs are subject to daily decay and rebalancing. Strict stop discipline is critical to manage the higher risk.

income.read: This income plan targets approximately 1% per month, prioritizing steady monthly distributions and low drawdown.
